name: Benifuji Yuria
source:
Screen name: JuliaDG
Class: Magician

[url=/c18358]Shuuho[/url]'s kouhai and [url=/c18315]Ririko's[/url] classmate. Yuria's parents are French, but married in Japan and naturalized Japanese, so she was born in Japan and grew up without any inconvenience in Japanese culture and language. She and her parents are actual magicians, so naturally she too chose the magician class. 

She saw that Ririko has great qualities in magic, so she always imitates her in a strange ceremony that produces unexpected and sudden fear. Because her level is way too low, she cannot use magic properly in Wizard Generation, which makes her frustrated because she's on the same level as normal people.
